items.title: FIELD REPORT
items.text:
FIELD REPORT
We found a locked storage room containing supplies that will help us for the rest of the year. This has given us great hope.
Renewed Hope
The current player gains 4 additional actions to do this turn.
Hidden Supply Cache
Immediately take up to 15 cubes from the reserve and put them in the stockpile.
Put this sticker on the game board onto Area 11 as a reminder to add 15 more Supply cubes to the stockpile during setup each month.
